items.item: Overview §7 (H1, H2, H3, H5, H6, H7, H8, H9, H10)
items.how: Read on relations: the reach reading; nothing lies outside each center's reach along that relation; read across all steps, in either order, saying nothing of what comes before what (08 §2's words); along affecting too (`Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent`); on an acyclic relation, where it holds, every standpoint has the same center (no dated-occurrences gloss). Lead paragraph: self-concern's formation is not shown, persisting a filter (07 §4.9). The condition and self-concern each represent a scope or a property of an order within the account; used as hypotheses, neither stands above becoming, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target. A new sentence, 'Emerges' names neither a derivation nor a shown development, followed by what is shown, offered and open (H10; 08 §2's sentence). Widening bullet: H1 at the theorem's strength, H2. It adds the missing hypothesis: each standpoint's own continuation marks exactly its center's closure, with the iff from every standpoint, on every listing and for every order (PremiseWitnesses.lean:395). It adds that `Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`'s proof uses the condition only at the life's own standpoint, that admissions end (H8), and the composition (H9). C is now a requirement on an order that may also rank mixed pairs and asks neither completeness nor transitivity (H5): it is no longer introduced as a second foundation, and the name stays for the requirement particular theorems take; its dated history is kept (E10). One-way paragraph: need not count, nothing in it requires their losses to count, witnessed by `Clearing.center_not_derived` and `Downstream.one_way`. Self-concern does not exclude them either (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_of_increasing`, checked at Weightings.lean:6005). The bold lead 'What every positive weighting shares' became 'What every additive positive weighting shares' (no anchor; nothing links it), with `widens_iff_every_positive` and `widens_iff_every_of_class` at their strength. Labels table 'conditional' row: 'the requirement C (`Comparison`)'. Case bullet's first C gloss: a requirement (H5).
